## Introduction

This appendix documents the application for controlling scheduled jobs and the details of the actual scheduled jobs for [Application]. A job scheduler is an application used for controlling unattended batch jobs, also known as "Batch Scheduling." Reference *SDP\_[Application]\_Appendix\_N\_Configuration\_Guides.docx* for configuration detail on the scheduler itself.
